visualCharacteristics.purpose: full-bleed video hero with eyebrow, H1, pause control and scroll-down link
visualCharacteristics.description: Full-width autoplay background video (1.mp4) with dark overlay; centered eyebrow + H1; pause button bottom-left; 'Explore the brand' jump link bottom-center | ~670px tall, white text over video | Full-bleed autoplay background video, centered eyebrow + H1, pause control and scroll-down jump link

contentPattern.structure: row 1 holds the background video as a link to an .mp4 (optionally plus a poster image); row 2 holds an eyebrow paragraph, the H1 and an optional in-page link (href starting with #) that becomes the scroll-down jump link
contentPattern.rationale: Full-bleed background media with overlaid headline is a hero; background video belongs to the block, so the section is not colored

usage: Page-top hero with a full-bleed looping background video, eyebrow, H1 and a scroll-down jump link.
reuseGuidance: Use when the hero background is a video (author the .mp4 as a link in row 1; an optional image in the same cell becomes the poster). Use hero-cta for photo backgrounds.
